## streetwear_lookbook_drop

> Drop-announcement lookbook plate — single street look with drop date and collection name.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1280`, aspect `4:5`
**Demo vars:** `templates/streetwear/_vars_examples/streetwear_lookbook_drop.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A vertical drop-announcement lookbook plate for the street label behind the "Atlas Studio Capsule 03" capsule, part of the spring transit collection. The plate is built around a single full-figure model wearing the drop look — anchored hood, layered jacket, statement bottoms, and footwear — set in a deliberately urban context. Typography sits as a hard counterweight to the figure rather than as decorative ornament.
[2. Action] The model holds a still drop pose — squared shoulders, weight centered, hands relaxed at the hips or in jacket pockets, gaze just past the camera. No walking, no jumping, no skating. The intent is a quiet flex: silhouette, layering, and footwear must read at a thumbnail. The viewer's eye drops from the figure to the drop name, then to the date plate, then to the item credits.
[3. Scene] A street-corner urban environment — a poured-concrete loading bay, a graffiti-washed alley wall, a tiled subway exit — chosen for tonal calm rather than visual chatter. Light is the gritty overcast of a working district. No cars passing, no crowds, no real-brand storefront signage in frame.
[4. Composition] Vertical 4:5 frame. Figure zone (~70%) holds the model full-figure from above the head to mid-shin, anchored slightly left of center. Right column (~30%) holds the drop name in a heavy condensed sans at the top, the drop date in a smaller cross-line beneath, and the item credits paragraph at the foot of the page in a quieter weight. Generous outer margins; layout reads as a printed zine plate.
[5. Style] Hype-aesthetic streetwear print — drop-culture zine sensibility, not editorial-runway gloss. Palette anchored in concrete grey and ink with a single charged accent in signal orange. Type system: a brutalist condensed sans for the drop name, a clean grotesk for date and credits. Garment fabric reads as photographed cloth, not rendered cloth. No teal-orange grading, no neon glow, no glamour-retouched skin.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- drop_name: "Atlas Studio Capsule 03"
- drop_date: "Drops Friday, May 9"
- item_credits: "Hooded shell, cargo pant, trail runner"

Preserve (edit mode only):
- garment silhouette
- footwear visibility

NO: real famous streetwear brand logos, copyrighted house monograms, real-celebrity likeness, editorial-runway gloss, HDR oversaturation, rainbow palette, cinematic teal-orange grading, lens flare, watermarks, heavy beauty retouching, clean digital plasticity, clip-art icons
```

## streetwear_sneaker_hero

> Single sneaker hero shot — stage-lit isolation plate for a fictional drop colorway.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1024`, aspect `1:1`
**Demo vars:** `templates/streetwear/_vars_examples/streetwear_sneaker_hero.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A 1:1 hero plate of a single fictional sneaker, the "Riser Footwear Drift 02" in the Storm Grey / Ember colorway, released in 2026. The shoe is the sole protagonist of the frame — photographed from a clean lateral profile that flatters the silhouette, with the laces tied evenly and the tongue settled. No foot inside, no second shoe, no box, no model.
[2. Action] The sneaker is at rest in a held lateral hero pose, weight centered on the midsole, heel and toe equally lifted. The image is purely still — no motion blur, no panning streak, no kicked-up dust. Reflections and texture across upper, midsole, and outsole must describe materials honestly: knit knit, leather leather, rubber rubber.
[3. Scene] A controlled studio isolation set — the shoe sits on a polished concrete plinth or surface against a smooth tonal cyclorama. A soft contact shadow grounds the outsole. No street context, no in-use scene, no second sneaker, no shoebox. The atmosphere is calm and museum- grade rather than retail-loud.
[4. Composition] Square 1:1 frame. Sneaker silhouette occupies the central ~62% area at perfect lateral profile, sitting on the polished concrete surface line that runs across the lower third. Generous negative space wraps the silhouette. Model name sits as a quiet small caps line under the surface, with the colorway name as a smaller cross- line beneath. 6% safe margins on every edge.
[5. Style] Stage-lit hype-aesthetic sneaker isolation — drop-page hero plate sensibility. Lighting is a single soft key from upper-front with a low fill; no rim light, no theatrical chrome flare, no rainbow spill. Palette anchored in the colorway itself against a single neutral cyclorama. Type system: a clean grotesk in small caps. Materials must read photographed, not 3D-rendered glossy plastic.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- model_name: "Riser Footwear Drift 02"
- colorway: "Storm Grey / Ember"

Preserve (edit mode only):
- sneaker silhouette
- midsole and outsole geometry

NO: real famous sneaker brand logos, copyrighted swoosh / stripe / trefoil marks, real-celebrity collab references, foot inside the shoe, second shoe in frame, shoebox in frame, 3D rendered glossy plastic, chrome lens flare, rainbow palette, HDR oversaturation, watermarks, clip-art icons
```
